'''Law and crime'''
*[[2026 Cuban crisis]]
**[[Cuba]]n authorities arrest five people after a small group of protesters [[vandalism|damaged]] and [[arson|set fire]] to a [[Communist Party of Cuba|Communist Party]] office in [[Morón, Cuba|Morón]], [[Ciego de Ávila Province]], during demonstrations over [[2024–2026 Cuba blackouts|prolonged blackouts]] and [[shortage]]s of basic goods. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2026/03/14/protesters-ransack-cuban-communist-party-office-state-media/ (AFP via ''Jamaica Observer'')]
*[[Antisemitism in Europe]]
**An [[explosion]] lightly damages a [[Jewish]] school in [[Amsterdam]], [[Netherlands]], with no reported injuries, making it the third attack against Jewish buildings in the [[Low Countries]] this week. [https://www.euronews.com/2026/03/14/explosion-damages-jewish-school-in-amsterdam-with-no-injuries-reported-mayor-says (Euronews)]
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
